roles.name: Client
goals: Review a gallery of photos from an autumn portrait session.
Leave optional editing notes on selected photos.
Submit the selection to the photographer.
Persist selections and notes across page reloads.
Start over if needed after submission.

workflows.name: Find and inspect

steps.result: Window Light is the only result
Title, category, and image match expected values

steps.action: Clear search and select Outdoor filter

workflows.success: Client successfully searched and filtered photos
workflows.failure: Search or filter does not work as expected
workflows.recovery: Client clears search or resets filters to continue

workflows.name: Select, annotate, and persist

steps.result: Photo added to shortlist, count updates
Note saved locally with character count shown

steps.action: Add four other photos to selection
steps.result: Five photos selected, no duplicates allowed

steps.action: Attempt to add a sixth photo
steps.result: Limit explained, original five remain unchanged
Same five records and note displayed

workflows.success: Client selects, annotates, and persists selections correctly
workflows.failure: Selection limit not enforced or notes do not persist
workflows.recovery: Client removes a photo to make room, reloads page to verify persistence

workflows.name: Remove and replace

steps.result: Photo added to shortlist, count updates

steps.action: Confirm correct five in sample-data order
steps.result: Five photos displayed in correct order

workflows.success: Client removes and replaces photos correctly
workflows.failure: Count does not update or note is lost when switching photos
workflows.recovery: Client checks shortlist count and reopens photo to verify note

workflows.name: Submit and lock

steps.action: With fewer than five selected, attempt submission
Open submission dialog again and confirm
Confirm Submitted status, timestamp, and correct five photos

workflows.success: Client submits selection correctly and state is locked
workflows.failure: Submission allowed with fewer than five or state not locked
workflows.recovery: Client selects correct number of photos and confirms submission is locked

workflows.name: Start over

steps.action: Open Start over again and confirm
steps.result: Empty Draft selection and cleared notes

workflows.success: Client starts over correctly after submission
workflows.failure: Start over does not clear data or reload fails
workflows.recovery: Client confirms reset and reloads to verify state
